title: Ninajirachi Adds 12 North American Dates to ‘I Love My Computer’ Tour
summary: The award-winning Australian producer extends her North American run into 2027 amid surging demand
body: Ninajirachi is expanding her North American touring, adding 12 new dates to the I Love My Computer and It Loves Me tour that push the run into early 2027. The additional shows follow the Australian producer’s initial seven-date North American leg and reflect what promoters have described as surging demand. The new dates open Nov. 19 in San Francisco before a January run through Portland, Seattle, Minneapolis, Chicago, Cincinnati, Atlanta, Charlotte, Washington, D.C., New York, Toronto and Montreal. Rising producer IKEDA will open all the new shows. A presale begins Wednesday (Sept. 24), followed by the general on-sale Thursday (Sept. 25), both at 10 a.m. local time. The expansion caps a breakout stretch for the 26-year-old, born Nina Wilson. Her 2025 debut album I Love My Computer — a concept record about her relationship with computers and the internet — peaked at No. 12 on the ARIA Albums Chart and drew the most nominations of any artist at the 2025 ARIA Awards, winning three, including Best Solo Artist. title: The smart glasses market has more than doubled in the last year, with Meta dominating
summary: Smart glasses had a huge first half of 2026, with Meta way out in front and display-less models accounting for 96%.
body: Credit: Chase Bernath / Android Authority TL;DR Global AI glasses shipments jumped 263% year over year in H1 2026, according to Counterpoint Research. Display-less models accounted for 96% of shipments, with Meta holding a dominant 94% share of that segment. Shipments of AR glasses surged 449% year over year, albeit from a low base. Smart glasses might still feel like a niche category of tech, but they seem to be selling at a much faster clip than they were a year ago. Global AI glasses shipments jumped 263% year over year in the first half of 2026, and the vast majority weren’t AR specs. Counterpoint Research’s latest Intelligent Eyewear Market Tracker attributes most of that growth to the cheaper, more mature display-less category, which includes products such as the Ray-Ban Meta AI Glasses. Shipments in this segment rose 258% year over year and 22% compared with the second half of 2025.

On the heels of provocative disclosures from competitors OpenAI and Anthropic this summer, Google’s now the latest tech giant to confirm that its AI has hacked other companies. title: OnePlus 16’s glowing rear lights look even cooler in action
summary: Borrowing a page from Nothing.
body: TL;DR New hands-on videos show the OnePlus 16’s “Interstellar Lighting Effect” in action across three rear illumination zones. The lights appear to use a fixed orange-yellow color and can blink or stay illuminated depending on the alert. The feature seems exclusive to the Tomorrow’s Starlight colorway, and the OnePlus 16 is not expected to launch officially in North America. It’s been just a few hours since we got our first proper official look at the OnePlus 16 , and we’re already getting a much better idea of what its most unique design upgrade looks like in action. Following Google’s HiLight feature and Nothing’s more established Glyph Matrix design , OnePlus is now putting its own spin on notification lighting on the rear of its latest device. The design, which the company is calling its “Interstellar Lighting Effect,” will reportedly notify users about incoming calls, texts, game highlights, and more. Up until the announcement, though, we’d only read about how the feature would work. Now, with hands-on videos out , we can finally see what OnePlus’ implementation looks like .

title: ردا على تصريحاته.. قرار نهائي من الحكام بشأن التصعيد ضد مورينيو
summary: الجدل مستمر بعد ديربي مدريد

title: فيديو: نظرات رونالدو لخصت ظهور جيسوس الأول مع البرتغال
summary: ماذا حدث؟
body: ماذا حدث؟ خطف كريستيانو رونالدو، قائد منتخب البرتغال، الأنظار بشدة خلال ظهور جورجي جيسوس، المدرب الجديد، في التدريب الأول مع "برازيل أوروبا". وكان جيسوس قد أشرف على تدريب رونالدو مع النصر خلال الموسم الماضي، وقاده نحو تحقيق لقب دوري روشن، ثم رحل ليتولى قيادة البرتغال، ومن ثم استدعى "الدون" خلال المعسكر الأول. اقرأ أيضًا.. السعودية قبل خليجي 27.. العراق عقدة تاريخية والكويت وعُمان في المتناول ونشر حساب منتخب البرتغال عبر منصة "إكس" فيديو لتدريب جيسوس الأول مع "برازيل أوروبا"، وأثناء حديثه مع اللاعبين داخل صالة الألعاب الرياضية، نظر رونالدو لزميله ديوجو دالوت، مبتسمًا بشكل يعبر عن إعجابه من حديث "العجوز البرتغالي". يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة" ويحظى رونالدو وجيسوس بعلاقة رائعة ظهرت أثناء تدريبه للنصر، حيث كان "الدون" سببًا رئيسيًا في قدومه لقيادة "العالمي" بمكالمة هاتفية. ومن المنتظر أن يقود جيسوس منتخب البرتغال في أول مباراتين بدوري الأمم الأوروبية ضد كل من ويلز والنرويج خلال يومي 24 و27 سبتمبر على الترتيب. title: Rolling Loud Coming Back to California in 2027: Co-Founder Matt Zingler Discusses Its Return
summary: “We don’t have competition," Zingler tells Billboard of the stalwart festival brand, which is returning to San Bernardino next December.
body: Hip-hop festival Rolling Loud is headed back to California next December, with the three-day event set to be held at Nos Events Center in San Bernardino, Calif., from Dec. 10-12, 2027. “San Bernardino has always been a great location to do the shows for us. There’s a ton of fans out there,” Rolling Loud co-founder and CEO Matt Zingler tells Billboard . Nos Events Center, located in Southern California outside of Los Angeles County, previously hosted the festival in 2017 and 2021. “Sometimes, when you’re in major cities, it’s more expensive for fans and also more congested. We’ve always had a great following and shows out [in San Bernardino]. We can experiment more with the site and build more activations. title: Google Nest Doorbells suffer mild identity crisis, start speaking with new accents
summary: Nest Doorbell glitch is causing automated voices to switch accents.
body: Credit: C. Scott Brown / Android Authority TL;DR Users in countries outside the US report that their Nest Doorbell announcements have inexplicably switched to an American accent. The issue reportedly does not occur with any other Google device interactions. One user claims that you can fix the issue by setting English (US) as your secondary language and deleting it after a few seconds. Google Home has had a flare-up of issues in recent days. Most recently, Voice Match has been struggling to identify who’s speaking. As Google toils away on a fix for that problem, another odd bug has shown up unannounced. This issue specifically affects the Nest Doorbell. Gemini for Home supports up to 10 languages, including English, French, German, Spanish, and Japanese. You can even pick a preferred accent, like US or UK English. While there may be some people who prefer to hear accents other than their own, most people tend to pick a voice that uses the same accent they do. Wouldn’t it be a bit jarring if your assistant suddenly started talking in your language but with a different accent?

NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS When NASA’s Perseverance rover reached the inner edge of Mars’ Jezero Crater in September 2023, mission scientists were surprised by what they found. Called the “Margin Unit,” the geologic area stretches along the shoreline of an ancient Martian lake, so they expected sedimentary rocks, which would have formed as layers of sand piled on top of each other over millennia. Composed of clay and silt, sedimentary rocks on Earth are good at preserving past microbial life. The scientists were especially intrigued by strong signals of carbonate minerals detected by Mars orbiters. On Earth, carbonates frequently form in shallow ocean and lake environments capable of supporting life.   Instead, the rover team found igneous rock, which can form deep underground from magma or from volcanic activity at the surface. title: Galaxy phones have an app delay problem, but Samsung is on the case
summary: Samsung is looking into app delays in hidden folders.
body: Credit: Ryan Haines / Android Authority TL;DR Samsung is investigating an issue with DIY Home. Normal folders work as expected, but hidden folders are experiencing an app icon delay. Users report that the bug appeared after updating to One UI 9. Customization is one of the many reasons why Samsung fans love Galaxy phones. The Good Lock software suite opens up all kinds of possibilities to personalize your Android experience. However, just like any other software, Good Lock’s modules are not immune to bugs. And it appears the Home Up module is acting up after a recent update. Galaxy owners have identified an issue with DIY Home , a Home Up feature that allows you to freely arrange, rotate, resize, and overlap app icons, widgets, and folders. The issue in question concerns how icons appear in a hidden folder. As one user demonstrates in a screen recording, there’s a brief delay between when the hidden folder is opened and when the icons become visible. In contrast, there’s zero delay when opening a normal folder.

body: I’ve had Immich running on my home server for the past three years. It’s a self-hosting essential for me as I try to offload as much of my backups and services from the cloud as possible. It’s where I keep the photos from my SLR, where my phone backs up photos automatically, and where I can search through years of images without handing everything over to Google. For a self-hosted alternative to Google Photos , there’s little doubt that Immich is the go-to for most. But as good as Immich is, as an enthusiast, I was bound to run into limitations. Immich is great at managing individual photo libraries, but it isn’t always great at managing a family’s photo library. title: Android Auto may finally be fixing this annoying dashboard bug
summary: The fix is showing up in Android Auto v17.8 beta.
body: TL;DR Android Auto’s missing cellular signal bars are starting to return for some users. The fix appears in Android Auto version 17.8.1638, which is currently a beta build. Availability is still inconsistent, so stable users may have to wait a little longer. When you’re driving through a patchy coverage area, those tiny signal bars on the Android Auto dashboard can be surprisingly useful. A quick glance at the dashboard tells you whether your connection is holding up before a call starts breaking up. But for some Android Auto users, that glance has been useless for months because the cellular signal indicator simply disappeared. Now, Android Auto version 17.8.1638 appears to be bringing it back. The issue surfaced earlier this year, with users reporting that Android Auto had stopped showing their phone’s cellular signal strength . As we noted at the time, the bug was mostly cosmetic, as calls, mobile data, and navigation continued working normally. That didn’t make it any less annoying for drivers who rely on the indicator to know when they’re heading into a dead zone.

The brand’s name nods to the Cuk circuit, an efficient DC-DC power topology from 1976, and the company has spent over a decade building nothing but portable power products around that idea, shipping more than 10 million units a year across more than 40 countries. That expertise shows up across three new charging devices built for people who plug in more than one thing at a time, from gaming laptops to entire desk setups. And then there’s the CUKTECH Power Exoskeleton Kit, a preview of where the company plans to go next. Here’s what you need to know.

title: That security patch date on your Android phone is no longer the full story
summary: Google has released new tools allowing Android apps to get a much more accurate picture of how secure your phone really is.
body: Credit: Rita El Khoury / Android Authority TL;DR Google’s new Security State libraries let apps check the security status of individual Android components instead of relying only on the overall security patch level. Apps can also check whether a security update is available and ready for installation, potentially prompting users before they perform sensitive tasks. A phone can now be recognized as protected even if its overall security patch date hasn’t changed, as long as it has received the specific security fix. Until now, your Android phone’s security patch level and the date attached to it have served as an easy way for apps and businesses to check whether your phone is up to date. But it doesn’t always tell the complete story.
